shown.message:
I asked for changes again on `paper-repo` PR #13, now at `e50c738`. The ordering sentence is still wrong, and this time the error comes from the range I gave last turn.

I said the model-based predictors and plug-ins span 0.59–0.78 at gaps of 4–8 points. That excluded two cells I had misread. Balanced × ridge model (0.879) and balanced × ridge plug-in (0.881) are as accurate as the sample mean. The other 38 of the 40 model-based cells span 0.59–0.79. I suggested wording that gives the 0.59–0.79 range and notes the balanced-design ridge exception.

The paper's 0.86–0.89 for the sample-mean, calibrated-regression and difference-corrected methods checks out against `pairwise_bands.csv`. `code/` is unchanged, and the only other change since the last head is a font fix in `main.tex`. One phrase in my review text ("6 estimators × 7 designs, minus the 2 naive...") is garbled. The 38-of-40 count is correct.

I'll approve the next head once that sentence is fixed. Issue #7 stays open until then.
